description_en: Configures the virtual waiting room feature for an accelerated domain name. This operation is available only for accelerated domain names of the Dynamic CDN workload type
description_zh: 调用SetWaitingRoomConfig设置waiting_room功能，只支持全站加速类型域名
kebab_example: aliyun cdn set-waiting-room-config --domain-name example.com --wait-uri .0/aaa/bbb --allow-pct 30 --max-time-wait 30 --gap-time 20 --wait-url https://example.com/waitingroom.html --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetWaitingRoomConfig

parameters.help_en: The accelerated domain name. You can specify only one domain name
parameters.help_zh: 您的加速域名，仅支持单个设置
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The regular expression that is used to match URI strings for which the virtual waiting room feature is enabled
parameters.help_zh: 开启waiting_room功能的URI正则字符串
parameters.name: wait_uri

parameters.help_en: The percentage of requests that are allowed to be redirected to the origin server. Valid values: 0 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 允许回源比例，取值范围：0~100
parameters.name: allow_pct

parameters.help_en: The maximum length of waiting time in the queue. Unit: seconds
parameters.help_zh: 进入排队后，排队时长，单位：秒
parameters.name: max_time_wait

parameters.help_en: The length of waiting time to skip after an exit from the queue. Unit: seconds
parameters.help_zh: 离开排队后，跳过排队时长，单位：秒
parameters.name: gap_time

parameters.help_en: The URL of the waiting page
parameters.name: wait_url
